'''Daisuke Namikawa''' (Japanese: '''浪川大輔''' ''Namikawa Daisuke'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Namikawa was born on April 2, 1976 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He began to provide voices for the series in [[M08|the eighth movie]], where he portrayed {{OBP|Lucario|M08}}. He reprised the role in [[Super Smash Bros. Brawl]], and also voiced [[Lucian]] of the [[Sinnoh]] [[Elite Four]] during {{aniseries|DP}}. In the {{aniseries|SM|''Sun & Moon'' series}} he received two major roles, playing the {{an|Rotom Pokédex}} and [[Jessie's Mimikyu]].
